name: Haunani-Kay Trask
shortBio: Kanaka Maoli (Native Hawaiian) political philosopher and sovereignty theorist who exposed U.S. settler colonialism, corporate tourism, and Western feminist universalism in the Pacific.
centralQuestion: Why does genuine Hawaiian sovereignty demand rejecting settler-state multiculturalism and restoring Kanaka Maoli genealogical kinship with land (āina)?

keyWorks.title: From a Native Daughter: Colonialism and Sovereignty in Hawaiʻi
keyWorks.description: Incisive anti-colonial philosophy dismantling settler historiography, anthropological extraction, and militarized tourism.
